blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The camp of former House Speaker and Leyte Representative Martin Romualdez will submit its answer by Monday as to why he should not be preventively suspended as a lawmaker by the Sandiganbayan, his lawyer Ade Fajardo said on Thursday. On Sept. 16, Associate Justice Karl Miranda, the Sandiganbayan Third Division chair, gave Romualdez’s 10 days to explain why he should not be preventively suspended. “We will most likely file Monday, which is the deadline,” Fajrdo told Inquirer in a text message.
